item.tib: dbang drag 'bar ba me phreng gi rgyud las yang gsang rta mchog rol pa'i thugs sgrub me'i 'khor lo 'bar ba
item.coloph: o rgyan bde chen gling pa 'gyur med tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa bdag gis shing stag zla ba lnga pa'i tshes 30 nyin la g.yu lung shel brag gam pad+ma bkod legs gnyis pa gnas chen seng ge yongs rdzong gi nye 'dabs rdo rje gsang brag nas thon cing sngar bsil ldan gangs kyi khor yug gtam pa'i ra ba na che ba mtshon pa'i shel bzhin tshul ming kir ti'i (tis) kyang bstan snying gso zhing gter gsar spel nas legs mdzad phra mo yan la brtson pa lhur len dgos zhes kyi bka' dang phyi lo gcig dang zla ba 6 gi gsang rgya yol tshe lung mthun kyi chos bdag bla khri rgyal ba g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyis rkyen bskul cing nye bar rtsa grogs g.yung drung bstan pa rgyal mtshan gyis legs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar ste mdor na ma sgrigs rten 'brel rang 'grigs kyi brda rtags byung tshe brda yig la thar bde smin grol gyi 'od gsal chen khang du zhal bshus pas bstan 'gro phan bde'i rgyu ru shog cig
